description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:256: IssuerDnContains variant doc says 'The stored substring must be pre-lowercased' but this is a hidden invariant with no enforcement. The test at line 943 explicitly tests the silent-failure behavior with an uppercase substring. A contributor reading only the struct definition and not the full doc would not know this constraint. The fix: either auto-lowercase in DeviationStore::add (most operator-friendly), or return DeviationAddError::InvalidScope for uppercase IssuerDnContains substrings, or at minimum add an assert_debug in the matches() path.
title: IssuerDnContains 'pre-lowercased' invariant not checked at construction time
